insights.body: App Total Revenue on 08-28 vs 08-21 is +3.9%, but App Total New Subs on 08-21 vs 08-14 was -1.4% — they moved in opposite directions. Most new subs start as a 7-day free trial, so the revenue landing now mostly comes from people who subscribed about 7 days ago. Since those subs went the other way, this growth is coming from existing customers instead: check renewals and cancellations, refunds, or a recent price change — not marketing or installs.

insights.title: Installs to subs, by app — YMK is turning installs into New Subs worse than usual (-5.6% vs Install +2.1%).
insights.body: Some apps are not converting installs into subscribers at their usual rate: YMK New Subs -5.6% vs Install +2.1% (worse than its installs); YCP New Subs -10.3% vs Install +6.2% (worse than its installs). Revenue follows about a week later, so these are the apps to watch next week.

insights.title: Which app — App Total New User -4.6% is mostly YMK — not every app.
insights.body: App Total New User moved -4.6% overall, but the apps are far apart (All App -4.6%, YMK -6.9%, YCP -6.1%, YCV +0.2%). YMK accounts for most of it, so look at what changed in that one app rather than something affecting all of them.

insights.title: Which country — GB is out of line with every other country on App Total Revenue (+62.6% vs +0.6%).
insights.body: For All App, App Total Revenue in GB is +62.6% while all countries together are +0.6% — a gap of +62.0pp. GB is about 7% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.

insights.title: Install source — App Total Install +3.4% — Organic Install is behind most of it (94% of the change).
insights.body: App Total Install was 30,444, against 29,448 for the average of the same weekday over the past 4 weeks — a change of +996. Where that came from: Organic Install +938 (94% of the change, +6.7%), SEO Install +73 (7% of the change, +3.5%), Paid Install +14 (1% of the change, +0.1%). Organic Install accounts for 94% of the change on its own and is now 49.1% of all installs, so that is the channel to look at first.

insights.title: Best and worst markets — GB turns installs into new subs best of anywhere (23.6% vs 11.9% overall).
insights.body: In GB, 23.6% of installs turn into new subs, versus 11.9% across all markets and apps (+11.7pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. GB is about 7% of revenue.

insights.title: Next period outlook — No big App Total Revenue swing expected in about 7 days — the share of installs that become subs is normal.
insights.body: App Total New Subs is -4.9% and App Total Install is +3.4%; the gap between them (-8.3pp) is under the 10pp we treat as a real signal, so the share of people who install and then subscribe is close to normal. New subs start as 7-day free trials, so today's new subs are next period's App Total Revenue. So nothing unusual is building up that would swing App Total Revenue in about 7 days.
